item.title: Health alert issued for ground beef sold in 5 states and DC
item.description: Federal regulators are asking consumers in five states and the District of Columbia to check their freezers for possibly contaminated ground beef.

item.title: Man hogties partner, urinates on her while cutting off air with scarf during assault in DC
item.description: A 51-year-old man was found guilty for holding his romantic partner captive after an argument escalated, in which she escaped after being hogtied, according to the U.S. Attorney's Office in D.C.

item.description: A 19-year-old is facing 20 criminal charges after detectives linked him to four armed robberies in Arlington that targeted businesses.
